scope: VSR zero-shot train internal image-grouped train/validation/internal-test only; no official VSR dev/test use before all internal gates pass.
hypothesis: A prompt-order-aware three-slot subject/object/relation scorer with bounded spatial pair interactions can preserve the frozen B1 teacher ranking at K96 and distinguish authentic same-image prompt changes better than an order-invariant mean query.
single_change_from_failed_baseline: Replace the failed caption-mean query with one ordered three-slot bounded-pair scorer; retain B1, K96, caption spans, split, optimizer family, teacher, three seeds and 15 epochs.
architecture: ordered_three_slot_bounded_partner: T<=16 raw prompt rows -> 128-d asymmetric local text encoder -> latent subject/object/relation slots; B1 group features -> 128-d visual projection; global top-4 subject/object partners and six-term relative geometry; no GxG matrix

wrong_prompt.training: deterministic cyclic next prompt from the same multi-prompt image; samples from single-prompt images receive teacher KL only
wrong_prompt.diagnostic_cross: deterministic next sample from a different source_image_sha256 inside the same split

winner_selection: maximize the minimum of six image-equal validation 95% CI lower bounds: correct-minus-cross and correct-minus-same for Spearman, NDCG-full and K96 teacher mass; then correct-minus-L2 NDCG-full; then lower validation objective

promotion_gates.teacher_alignment: image-equal validation correct-minus-L2 Spearman and NDCG-full point estimates are both > 0
promotion_gates.cross_prompt_sensitivity: all three image-equal validation 95% CI lower bounds for correct-minus-cross are > 0
promotion_gates.same_image_prompt_sensitivity: all three image-equal validation 95% CI lower bounds for correct-minus-same are > 0
promotion_gates.internal_test: load and evaluate once only when every validation gate passes

stop_rule: If any strict validation gate fails, keep internal_test null, do not open its NPZ files, do not run VSR dev, and stop this ordered-pair candidate without hyperparameter tuning.

hardware_contract.fixed_layout: 87 real + 9 context, 3x3 anchors, local candidate cap 16
hardware_contract.note: float software development experiment; not quantized inference, HLS synthesis, routed timing or ZCU102 measurement
